passages.note: Wicks voted Aye on Assembly Floor concurrence in Senate amendments to AB 1228, 09/14/23.

passages.provision_quote: The hourly minimum wage for fast food restaurant employees shall be twenty dollars ($20) per hour, effective April 1, 2024.
passages.note: AB 1228 sets a $20/hour minimum wage only for fast food restaurant employees via an appointed Fast Food Council, not a general state wage floor.

rows.reasoning: Wicks's Aye vote on AB 1228 (2023-2024) raises a wage floor, but only for the fast food sector, via a council that may set capped annual increases ('the lesser of' 3.5% or CPI-W) rather than an automatic cost-of-living formula or a lawmaker-voted increase. This sector-specific, council-administered mechanism shows direction (support for a higher wage floor) but does not match the clauses of any single general minimum-wage rung, so it cannot separate rungs 1-5 for the general 'minimum wage' question.
